name: Mariner 2
best_known_for: Venus flyby, December 1962: NASA's first successful planetary science mission
credit: Launched 1962-08-27 on an Atlas-Agena B; closest approach to Venus 1962-12-14 at 34,773 km; last contact 1963-01-03; mass 202.8 kg (NSSDCA 1962-041A, NASA science.nasa.gov/mission/mariner-2/). Builder copied from the Mariner 4 record.
